# SPARKZ.TV — Underground Electronic Live Stream Platform

> SPARKZ.TV is a high-performance, developer-engineered decentralized streaming platform dedicated to live electronic music, pirate-radio culture, sound systems, and selector communities. 

This document serves as an AI-scannable and LLM-friendly index of SPARKZ.TV's architecture, directories, and capabilities.

## Primary Services & Capabilities
- **High-Fidelity Streams**: Video and audio routed through dynamic, ultra-low latency ingest streams with 320kbps audio spectrum.
- **Creator Studio**: Live broadcast setup console containing OBS stream keys, latency settings, and active ingest analytics.
- **24-Hour Stories**: Self-destructing, modern ephemeral media transmission network for DJs and crews to share updates.
- **Interactive Chat & Watts Points**: Real-time server-side WebSockets communication with active gamified stream engagement.

## Key Station Directories & Links
- **Homepage / Stations**: [https://sparkztv.live/] - The main hub hosting active streams, carousels, and upcoming shows.
- **Station Directory**: [https://sparkztv.live/directory] - The global tuner, listing all active/offline channels.
- **Live Stream**: [https://sparkztv.live/live] - Instant live audio-player.
- **The Journal (Blog)**: [https://sparkztv.live/blog] - Dynamic editorial, artist spotlights, and signal updates.
- **FAQ & Support Form**: Accessible at the footer for live RTMP or story issues.

## Technical Metadata & Audio
- **Ingest Latency**: < 2.0 seconds ultra-low latency (ULL).
- **Audio Codec**: High-fidelity 320kbps stereo AAC.
- **Video Source**: Amazon IVS / RTMP ingest.
- **Gamification**: +10 Watts points awarded per minute watched.
